title: Riemann Hypothesis and Polynomial-Time Factorization
content: This work presents a fully unified and algebraically expanded formulation of the Riemann Hypothesis and Semiprime Factorization equivalence. All binomial, convolutional, and spectral equations have been rewritten in large-scale explicit algebraic form, with step-by-step multiline expansions. The central construct — the Tripartite Binomial Function
